prompt: Square detailed painterly naturalistic encyclopedia illustration of Lamashtu, Mesopotamian fearsome demon-goddess of the underworld, based on British Museum amulet iconography. ONE upright female-shaped being with a LION HEAD AND MANE, broad donkey-like teeth visible in snarling muzzle, hairy humanlike body, long fingers and nails on TWO hands, TWO BIRD TALON FEET. She holds one natural SNAKE in each hand, stands with bird feet on the back of one small DONKEY standing in a low wooden BOAT upon a dark underworld river. Chest modestly covered in a coarse drape; do not depict infant feeding scene. Full figure, talons, donkey and boat clearly distinguishable and comfortably framed. Aura terrifying self-willed demonic divinity and oppressive underworld menace, ancient Mesopotamian night, cold dark water and ominous bronze lamplight. Detailed painterly hair and river textures. No horns, wings, human-head replacement, lion paws in place of talons, weapons, wounds, blood, victims, babies, gore, text or watermark.
